POST /api/proposals - creator can create proposal (returns id, title, status=draft)
POST /api/proposals/{id}/submit - submits draft and generates ARRIS insights
PATCH /api/proposals/{id} - admin can update proposal status (under_review)
GET /api/proposals/stats/summary - admin gets total_proposals, by_status, by_priority
GET /api/subscriptions/me/usage - returns proposals usage and tier
POST /api/waitlist/signup - new waitlist signup (requires email, name, creator_type)
GET /api/elite/dashboard - returns dashboard data (or 403 if not elite)

ARRIS insights generated on proposal submission - verified
